palettes.name: Goonstation
palettes.description: Goonstation's spriting palette: 20 color ramps, darkest first.
palettes.guidelines: Keep palettes small: build each sprite from a few of these ramps.

palettes.name: Goonstation Metals
palettes.description: Goonstation's metal ramps: brass, gold, silver, bronze, copper, iron and steel, darkest first.
palettes.guidelines: Use one metal ramp per material; outlines take the ramp's darkest step.
